campaign_logline: A pilot's debt is paid in scrap and cargo.
campaign_pitch: Debt collectors are closing in on the outer rim. You must secure trade routes for survival. Profit from the mines to stay ahead of the creditors.
campaign_story_summary: The Zenith Corporation owns the primary ore veins. Aurelia seeks independence through independent mining claims. The Vanguard protects the shipping lanes against pirate raids. A shortage of refined minerals causes prices to skyrocket. You navigate these tensions to clear your debts. Every shipment delivered is a step toward freedom.

opening.status_quo: Mining colonies are struggling with high fuel costs.
opening.visible_crisis: A shortage of refined minerals has crippled trade routes.
opening.hidden_crisis: The Zenith Corporation is hoarding supplies to manipulate market prices.
opening.why_now: Your debt collectors have issued a final notice.
opening.player_role: An independent pilot with an overdue bill.

mystery.question: Why are the mineral markets so unstable?
mystery.false_answer: Pirate raids are destroying the transport ships.
mystery.true_answer_hint: The Zenith Corporation is intentionally sabotaging their own supply lines to create a monopoly.
mystery.long_term_reveal_direction: A shadow organization plans to control all trade by controlling the scarcity.

kaelen.secret_angle: She knows exactly who is manipulating the market.
kaelen.address_rule: Refer to her as a broker or fixer.
kaelen.never_reveal_rule: Never mention her role in any official capacity.

factions.zenith_problem: They are monopolizing ore veins and creating artificial shortages.
factions.aurelia_problem: They want to break the monopoly but lack the resources to do so alone.
factions.aurelia_problem_2: They struggle with logistics and pirate activity in their zones.
factions.conflict_triangle: Zenith wants control, Aurelia wants freedom, Vanguard protects the lanes.
factions.neutral_space_pressure: Pirates and scavengers are moving into the empty gaps.

act_1.name: The First Shipment
act_1.goal: Deliver a haul of refined minerals to a nearby station.
act_1.opening_incident: A pirate ship is intercepted by your sensors during a delivery.
act_1.midpoint_turn: You discover that the shipment you are carrying is actually stolen from a Zenith site.
act_1.finale: You successfully deliver the cargo and receive a payment for your debts.
act_1.player_takeaway: The market is more complex than it seems.

starter_mission.title: Clear the Path
starter_mission.reason: A pirate ship has blocked the main trade route.
starter_mission.enemy_knows: The enemy is unaware of your presence until you engage.
starter_mission.after_effect: You clear the path and receive a small reward for it.

recurring_clue.name: Marked Cargo
recurring_clue.signal: A recurring symbol on stolen Zenith crates.
recurring_clue.first_appearance: Found during your first delivery mission.
recurring_clue.escalation: The number of marked crates appears to increase over time.
recurring_clue.payoff_hint: These marks indicate a coordinated effort to move goods outside the law.

rumor_trail.name: Shadow Trade
rumor_trail.hint_theme: Illegal trade routes and hidden markets.
clue_templates: The market is flooded with cheap, high-quality ore.
There are rumors of a secret tunnel in the belt.
rumor_trail.payoff: A hidden trade route that provides higher rewards for delivery.

horizon.gate_tease: The gates lead to systems with even more desperate resources.
horizon.new_system_reveal_rule: Do not mention any other factions or specific names of new systems.
horizon.future_pressure_tease: The demand for lure-based tactics and more complex trade routes is growing.
horizon.future_ore_or_upgrade_tease: Better ships will allow you to deliver more cargo and earn more profit.

regeneration_trigger.description: When a major arc is completed, new trade routes and hazards are added.

rules.humor_rule: Use dry, cynical humor about the fuel costs and debt.
rules.fallback: If no quest is available, offer a contract for basic cargo delivery.

story_questions_for_future_generation: What are the reasons for the competition between Zenith and Aurelia?
Why is there a marked cargo symbol on stolen crates?
How do the markets be manipulated by a single corporation?
Who are the people behind the shadow trade routes?
Where can you find more refined minerals in the outlands?
